paite: Huan, ginna tuh thil lamette om ngeia theihna, thil muhlouhte theihchetna ahi.
english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

paite: Huaiah tuh nidanglai miten phat aloh ngal ua.
english: For by this, the elders obtained testimony.

paite: Ginnain khovelte tuh Pathian thu a suktuah a hita chih I thei ua, huchiin thil muh theihte leng thil langtheitea siam ahi kei hi.
english: By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

paite: Ginnain Abelin Kaina sangin kithoihna hoihjaw Pathian kiangah a lana, huai jiakin mi dik hihna a mu chih, Pathianin a thilpiakte a pomna ah a theisaka; huan huai ginna jiakin aman tuh sih khit nungin thu a gen nalai ahi.
english: By faith, Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

paite: Ginnain Enok leng sihna chiamlou dinga lakmangin ana oma; huan, Pathianin alakmang jiakin muhtheih ahita keia; lakmanga aom main Pathian pahtak lam mi ahi, chih theihsakna amukhinta him hi.
english: By faith, Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

paite: Himahleh, ginna louin amah pahtak lammi hihvual ahi kei; Pathian kianga hongpaiin, amah tuh a om chih leh, a zong mite lohchingsakpa ahi chih, gin ding ahi.
english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

paite: Ginnain Noa tuh thil muh nailouhte lam thu ah Pathian hilha naomin, Pathian laudan siamin, a inkuansung hotdamna dingin longa bawla; huaiin khovel siamlouh a tangsakta a, ginna jiaka om diktatna gouluahpa ahong hi hi.
english: By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, or, reverence prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

paite: Ginnain Abraham tuh sapa a om laiin a gouluah ding muna lut dingin pai khiakna ding thu a muta a; huan, a paina lam ding leng theilouin a pai kheta a.
english: By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

paite: Ginnain gam chiam ah mi gama tam bang lelin a natamta nilouha, thuchiam kikhat gouluahpih ding Isak leh Jacobte toh puanin ahte a om ua;
english: By faith, he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

paite: Khua suangphumte nei, Pathian lam leh, bawl tuh, a ngak nilouh a.
english: For he looked for the city which has the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

paite: Ginnain Sara ngeiin leng, chiampa tuh muanhuai asak jiakin, teknungin leng chi pai theihna amu hi.
english: By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

paite: Huchiin, pasal khat, amah lah misi bang mai, akipan vana aksite banga tam, tuipiaua piaunel banga sim zohlouh suante a hongsuakta uhi.
english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

paite: Hiai mi tengtengten thilchiamte tangkhin hilou-in, himahleh huaite gamlapia galmuha nakipahpih hi jawin, leh lei ah jaw khualzin leh mikhual lel ahi uh chih kithei gigein, amaute tuh ginna neiin ana sita uh hi.
english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen TR adds “and being convinced of” them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

paite: Huchibanga thu na genten amau gam ding a zong uh chih ahih lang mahmah uhi.
english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

paite: A pawtsan gam uh lung gulh hile uh bel kikna hun lem muta mahmah ding ahi ngal ua.
english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

paite: Himahleh, tun bel gam hoihjaw sem deih ana hi ua, huai tuh vana om ahi; huchin Pathian, a Pathian uh chiha om tuh a zum kei hi; amau dingin khopi khat anangaihtuahsakta ngala.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

paite: Ginnain Abraham tuh zeta omin, Isak a lana; huan thuchiamte kipak taka sangpan tuh a tapa neihsun alan hi, huai lah
english: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one and only son;

paite: Isak ah na suante aki minloh ding, a chihpen ahia.
english: even he to whom it was said, “In Isaac will your seed be called”; Genesis 21:12

paite: Pathianin misi lak akipan nangawna kaithou theiin a sepa; huchiin gentehnadana genin, amah tuh misi laka kipan mu nawn ahi ngei nguta.
english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

paite: Ginnain Isakin thil hongtung dingte thu ah leng Jacob leh Esau vual a jawl a.
english: By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

paite: Ginnain Jacobin, a sih ding kuanin, Joseph tate vual a jawl tuaktuaka; achiangkhun dawna kingaiin Pathian a bia hi.
english: By faith, Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

paite: Ginnain Josephin, a sih ding kuanin, Isreal suante pawt ding thu a gena; a guhte vui ding tungtang ah thu a pia hi.
english: By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave instructions concerning his bones.

paite: Ginnain Mosi, a pian laiin, ngaungek mel hoihtak ahi a chih jiak un, kha thum sung a nu leh a pa selin a oma; kumpipa thupiak leng a lau kei uhi.
english: By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

paite: Ginna in, Mosi in a hopichin nung in, Pharo tanu, tapa a lawh a utkei a;
english: By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

paite: sawtlou kal a dia khelhna nawpna kipahpih sangin Pathian mite tawh sukgentheihna thuak a tel zawta hi;
english: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;

paite: Kris a muhsitna uh tuh Aigupta gam goute sang a sum thupizaw in angai a; kipahman piak ding tuh a et ziakin.
english: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

paite: Ginna in kimpipa thangpaihna tuh laulou in Aigupta gam a paisan a, muhtheihlouhpa a muh ziak in a thuak teitei hi.
english: By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

paite: Ginna in Paikan Ankuangluina leh sisan thehna a bawl a, ta masa hihmangthangpan amaute a khoih louhna ding in.
english: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

paite: Ginna in gam hula pai bangin Tuipi San a kai a; Aigupata ten tua bang a hih a tm sam ua, valh zawh in a omta uhi.
english: By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

paite: Ginna in Jeriko khawkulh ni sagih a um nung un a chimta hi.
english: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.

paite: Ginna in Rahab kizuaknu gingloute lakah a mangthang khawm ta kei, enkhete im neilou a a pahtak ziakin.
english: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

paite: Huan, bang kagen nalai dia? Gideon thute, Barak thute, Samson thute, Jeptha thute leh, David thute, Samuel thute, Jawlneite thute gen ni chile hang, hun in hon chinlou ding ahi ngala;
english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;

paite: Huaiten tuh ginna in gamte ala ua, thudik a vaihawm a zawng ua, thuchiamte atang ua, humpinelkai kamte a chihsak ua;
english: who, through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions, Daniel 6:22-23

paite: mei thil hihtheihna a hihmit ua, namsau hiam nangawn a pel ua, hatlouhna a kipan hattak a bawl in a om ua, kidouna bang ah mihat minthang ana hi ua, namdang kidou pawlte bang a taikek sak uhi.
english: quenched the power of fire, Daniel 3:1-30 escaped the edge of the sword, 1 Kings 19:1-3; 2 Kings 6:31-7:20 from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

paite: Numeiten a misite uh thounawn a mu ua; khenkhatte gim thuaksak in a om ua, thawhnawnna hoih zawsem a tan theihna ding un khahkhiakna a deih kei ua;
english: Women received their dead by resurrection. 1 Kings 17:17-23; 2 Kings 4:32-37 Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

paite: midangten leng nuihza bawlna leh vuak bang a thuak ua, ahi, huailou leng, kawlbut leh hentakna bang a tuak ua;
english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

paite: suang a den in a awm ua, singatna a attan in a awm ua, khemna a tuak ua, namsau a satlup in a awm ua; Belam vun leh kel vun silh in a vakvai ua; genthei takin, gimthuakin, sawi in a awm ua-
english: They were stoned. 2 Chronicles 24:20-21 They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. Jeremiah 26:20-23; 1 Kings 19:10 They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated

paite: Khawvel a mau tenna tak hilou mite- gamdai ah bang, tang a bang, guam ah bang, leikua ah bang, a vak avak uhi.
english: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

paite: Ahia, hiaitetengteng in, a ginnaziakun phat nalawh khin mahleuhleng thil chiam pen ana tang kei uhi;aziakbel, Pathianin eia ding a thil hawihza muhkhawlh a neih ziak a, ei tellou-a amaute hih bukima a awmlouh ding uh ahihziak ahi.
english: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

paite: aziakbel, Pathianin eia ding a thil hawihza muhkhawlh a neih ziak a, ei tellou-a amaute hih bukima a awmlouh ding uh ahihziak ahi.
english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.
